title: Vertices minus edges plus faces equals two, almost always
body: For convex polyhedra, V - E + F = 2, whether cube (8-12+6) or a geodesic dome with thousands of parts. Euler noticed it in 1750; it became the seed of topology, where the number reappears as a property of the surface, not the shape. Spheres give 2, a torus gives 0, a double torus -2, anatomy by arithmetic.
